answer: Cross-Epoch Habit Fingerprint. Each identity accumulates a private behavioural signature: timing distributions, interaction partners, resource paths. Enforcement compares these signatures across epochs; a sharp discontinuity flags the identity as suspect. The signature must harbor enough entropy that forging it requires sustained, costly imitation. Honest drift is tolerated like a garden growing seasonally. To pass, a sybil must maintain a coherent grove of habits across many epochs, paying continuous compute and coordination cost per identity.
